t: This is the National Liberal Club, a private members' club open to men and women. It was established in 1882 to give Liberal campaigners club facilities after the electorate was enlarged, and it was meant to be more accessible than a traditional London club. William Gladstone, who was prime minister four times and the face of the Liberal Party, is named as its founder, alongside Robert Spence Watson, a reformer and influential Liberal. Alfred Waterhouse designed the building. He is also known for the Natural History Museum. Since 1947 the club has also been home to Liberal International.
